description:
Hushfeed v0.27.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

This one is about the settings screens finally being done with English. Around eighty strings still went out in English whatever your phone was set to, nearly all of them in the Feature Gate Lab: the gate details page top to bottom, both override switches and the sentences under them, the overflow menu, the filter, the buttons that reset or force a selection, and nineteen of its messages. The close button on the Lab's search box and the three buttons under the tab picker went with them. All of it is in the four tables now, in German, Spanish, Indonesian and Brazilian Portuguese.

Two of the Lab's lines count things and were built from a verb, a number and a couple of tails. No table row can hold half a sentence, and the plural rule of the language never got a say. Those are whole sentences now with the counts as placeholders, and so are the export count and the four-part import summary.

Fixed here: an undo of a settings backup said your settings had been restored when the copy it put back held Feature Gate Lab rules for another TikTok build. The list under the diagnostics picker read "Includes downloads, errors events.", lower-cased from labels that every table capitalises, which suits English and nothing else; it reads "Includes these events: Downloads, Errors" now. And thirteen translations were wrong rather than awkward, including two that named a setting by a title it does not carry in that language.

Also here: the README named two patches by names they lost in 0.26.0, so looking either one up in Morphe Manager found nothing. The 0.26.0 notes said seven patches were renamed when ten were. If you had Hide content warnings, Fit video to the screen, Uncap the refresh rate, Enable non-personalized search, Enable Live search, Show seekbar, Show seekbar thumbnail, Disable long-press quick share or Disable long-press repost selected, select them again.

Validation: 823 runtime tests passed locally, plus seventeen in the patches module. The bundle carries 70 patches, passed checks for all three DEX payloads, and applied cleanly to the vendor APK. It is byte reproducible: two builds of this commit produce the same file. Needs Morphe Manager 1.29.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
